description: Search pai.pt (Páginas Amarelas, Portugal's business directory) by keyword, category and location, or fetch full business profiles from URLs.

categories.description: One or more pai.pt category slugs, e.g. 'restaurantes', 'advogados'. Each category is searched in every location below. Takes priority over the single Category field.
categories.title: Category slugs (multi-category)

category.description: A common business category. Choose 'Custom category' to type a slug below instead.
category.title: Category

customCategory.description: A pai.pt category URL slug not in the list above, e.g. 'canalizadores-e-picheleiros'. Used only when the category fields are empty.
customCategory.title: Custom category slug

customLocation.description: A city, district or island name not in the list above, e.g. 'Vila Franca de Xira' or 'Distrito de Braga'. Used only when the location fields are empty.
customLocation.title: Custom location

fetchDetails.description: Visit each search result's profile page to add email, website, coordinates, rating, all phones, gallery, services and feature groups. Disable for a faster card-only scan.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full business profiles

location.description: A Portuguese city or concelho. Leave as 'Any location (nationwide)' to search across Portugal.
location.title: Location

locations.description: Cities, municipalities, districts or islands, e.g. 'Lisboa', 'Porto', 'Distrito de Braga'. Each is resolved through pai.pt's own location suggestions. Leave empty to use the single Location field.
locations.title: Locations (multi-location)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of business records to return across all searches.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages to read for each keyword/category/location combination. Pai.pt caps a search at 50 pages.
maxPages.title: Max pages per search

minRating.description: Keep only businesses rated at least this many stars. Businesses without a rating are kept because pai.pt only shows ratings after reviews.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: Choose 'Search businesses' to search by keyword/category and location, or 'Fetch profiles by URL' to read specific pai.pt profile pages.
mode.title: Mode

openNowOnly.description: Keep only businesses that are open now, computed from their published opening hours in the Europe/Lisbon timezone. Businesses without published hours are kept.
openNowOnly.title: Open now only

searchQueries.description: What you would type into pai.pt, e.g. 'canalizador' or 'restaurante'. Each keyword is searched in every location below. Leave empty when using a category instead.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

startUrls.description: Pai.pt search URLs, category URLs, business profile URLs, or a pai.pt/public listings sitemap URL (for example the public listings.xml.gz sitemap) to enumerate profiles beyond a single search.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Pai.pt Business Directory Input
